subject: general
question: Choose the correct meaning of the given idiom/phrase from the options:**"A slap on the wrist"**

options.text: A mild warning or light punishment

solution:
The correct answer is: **2 i.e. A mild warning or light punishment.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"A slap on the wrist"** means a mild reprimand or a light punishment for a mistake or wrongdoing. (हल्की फटकार या सजा)

 
 
• **Example:** The boy was caught stealing candy, but all he got was a slap on the wrist from his teacher.
 

 
• It is often used when the punishment for an offense is perceived to be too lenient or insufficient to deter the wrongdoer.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **2 i.e. A mild warning or light punishment.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **1) A painful injury **(दर्दनाक चोट): Refers to physical harm that causes pain and discomfort.

 
 
• **Example:** He suffered a painful injury after falling off his bike.
 
 

 
• **3) A friendly gesture **(मित्रतापूर्ण इशारा): A kind or warm-hearted action meant to show goodwill.

 
 
• **Example:** Offering to carry her bags was a friendly gesture.
 
 

 
• **4) A public compliment **(सार्वजनिक प्रशंसा): A positive acknowledgment or praise given in front of others.

 
 
• **Example:** She received a public compliment for her outstanding performance.

सही उत्तर है: **2 अर्थात् एक हल्की चेतावनी या हल्का दंड।**
